readmeMarkdown:
Context Relay

Zero-UI native /fork for Google Antigravity
One-click denoised conversation forking · Live sidebar title sync · 0-token bloat nudges · Lossless Git-grounded handoffs · 20-class secret redaction

Quick Start · /fork vs /compact · Commands · Security · Changelog

--- ## Why Context Relay? Long AI coding sessions degrade fast: build logs, progress bars, failed retries, and repeated file reads silently bloat your context window to 300k–500k+ tokens. Summarizing in place loses exact code details, while starting from scratch wastes 10 minutes re-explaining your repo state. **Context Relay** stays completely invisible until you need it — no sidecar web apps, no manual turn-checkbox forms, no cloud LLM summarization:

## `/fork` vs `/compact` When a session gets heavy, Context Relay's 0-token `PreInvocation` hook lets you choose between two complementary native paths: | Need | Command | How It Works | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Compress in-place** (keep the same thread) | `/compact` *(Antigravity built-in)* | Uses an LLM to summarize earlier turns inside the current thread. | | **Lossless denoised fresh session** *(zero summarization degradation)* | **`/fork`** *(Context Relay)* | **0-LLM deterministic surgery**: trims bulky tool noise, grounds real `git status`/`git diff`, preserves 100% verbatim goals & conclusions with lossless `transcript_full.jsonl` traceback, redacts 20 secret classes, reads your live renamed sidebar title, inherits your model, and launches ` (fork)` in one click. | ### Highlights (`v0.2.2`) - **One-Click `/fork`, Zero Popups**: Typing `/fork` opens no modals or webpages — it immediately denoises your active session in the same workspace and replies with a 2-line receipt plus a clickable `[Title (fork)](conversation://<id>)` instant-jump link. - **Live Sidebar Title Sync (Zero SQLite)**: Reads Antigravity's plain-text `annotations/<id>.pbtxt` so your renamed sidebar title is preserved verbatim (`Auth Refactor` → `Auth Refactor (fork)` → `Auth Refactor (fork #2)`). - **Ultra-Clean `/` Menu**: Only `/fork` appears in Antigravity's slash-command menu (legacy aliases `relay` and `context-relay` stay hidden via `disable-slash-command: true`). - **0-Token Context Bloat Nudge**: `hooks/nudge.mjs` injects subtle inline `metadata.user_markdown` reminders with **0 model tokens** only when noise crosses threshold (opt out anytime via `CONTEXT_RELAY_NUDGE=0`). - **Cross-Project & Turn-Bounded Forking**: Move curated context straight into another registered workspace (`/fork <project-keyword>`) or branch cleanly from an earlier turn (`/fork until turn N`). - **Shareable Token-Savings Card (`stats --svg`)**: Track real cumulative tokens saved with `/fork stats` or generate a crisp GitHub-ready SVG benchmark card via CLI. - **Zero Dependencies & 100% Local**: Pure Node.js ESM (`>= 22.15.0`) — no `npm install`, no telemetry, no external API calls. --- ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **Node.js `>= 22.15.0`** (zero runtime dependencies). ### Option A — Direct Clone Into Antigravity Plugins Directory (Recommended) ```bash git clone https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/ContextRelay.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-relay ``` Antigravity automatically discovers `plugin.json`, activates the `PreInvocation` bloat-nudge hook and `Stop` incremental indexer (`hooks.json`), and exposes `/fork` in your `/` menu. ### Option B — Local Clone + Installer CLI (Custom Data Directory) ```bash git clone https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/ContextRelay.git ContextRelay cd ContextRelay node bin/context-relay.mjs install antigravity --data-dir <custom-dir> ``` --- ## Everyday Commands | What You Type in Antigravity | What Happens | | :--- | :--- | | `/fork` | **0 popups** — immediately denoises the current conversation in the original folder, names it `<Live Sidebar Title> (fork)`, inherits the active model, and returns a clickable `conversation://<id>` link. | | `/fork <folder-keyword>` | Plans target workspace match (`exact` → instant `--go` with 0 popups; `ambiguous` → 1 native `ask_question` card; `not_found` → explains registering the folder in left `Projects` or exporting). | | `/fork until turn N` | Deterministically branches up to turn `N` (`--until <N>`) into a clean session without later detours. | | `/fork stats` | Reports cumulative tokens saved across forks and can export a GitHub SVG war-report card (`--svg`). | | `/fork search <keyword>` | Full-text searches indexed historical sessions (including live renamed titles) and returns clickable `[<Title>](conversation://<sessionId>)` links. | ### Environment Variables | Variable | Effect | | :--- | :--- | | `CONTEXT_RELAY_NUDGE=0` | Disable automatic 0-token `PreInvocation` bloat reminders completely. | | `CONTEXT_RELAY_DATA_DIR=<dir>` | Override local index/archive/stats storage directory. | --- ## CLI Reference ```bash # 1. One-click in-place denoised fork (original folder, live sidebar title + "(fork)") node bin/context-relay.mjs fork --session <conversation-id> --go --json # 2. Plan / execute cross-project or turn-bounded fork (or --export-only) node bin/context-relay.mjs fork --session <conversation-id> --plan --to "<project-or-path>" [--until <N>] --json node bin/context-relay.mjs fork --session <conversation-id> --go [--to "<project-id>"] [--preset smart-clean|backbone] [--until <N>] [--note "<extra-instruction>"] [--export-only] --json # 3. View cumulative token savings & export a personal GitHub SVG card node bin/context-relay.mjs stats --json node bin/context-relay.mjs stats --svg ./my-savings.svg --json # 4. Full-text search across indexed historical Antigravity sessions node bin/context-relay.mjs search "<query>" --limit 10 --json # 5. Inspect turns & export deterministic Git-grounded handoff bundle node bin/context-relay.mjs inspect <conversation-id> node bin/context-relay.mjs export <conversation-id> # 6. Install / uninstall Antigravity plugin wiring node bin/context-relay.mjs install antigravity --data-dir <custom-dir> node bin/context-relay.mjs uninstall antigravity ``` <details> <summary><strong>Optional: Offline Local Web Debugger (<code>serve</code>)</strong></summary> Normal Antigravity usage requires **no web UI**. For power users who want an offline browser inspector, an optional loopback-only server is available: ```bash node bin/context-relay.mjs serve --port 3477 # Open http://127.0.0.1:3477 ``` </details> --- ## Security & Privacy - **Zero Dependencies, 100% Local**: Pure Node.js ESM (`>= 22.15.0`). No external packages, no telemetry, no cloud LLM calls. - **Strict Read-Only Boundary (Zero `.sqlite` Access)**: Reads only local `transcript*.jsonl` logs and plain-text `annotations/<id>.pbtxt` titles, and interacts solely via public local `agentapi` interfaces. **Never** opens, queries, or modifies private `.sqlite` / `.db` files. - **20-Category Built-In Secret Redaction**: Automatically scrubs API keys, GitHub/AWS/Slack/HF/npm tokens, bearer/basic auth headers, database URLs, and PEM private keys before exporting or forking context. - **Zero-Delete Cross-Process Locking**: Uses kernel-atomic `openSync('wx', 0o600)` + `renameSync` release with stale dead-PID recovery — verified 200/200 zero lost updates across 8 concurrent Windows processes without calling destructive delete APIs. - **Loopback & CSRF Hardening**: Optional `serve` binds strictly to `127.0.0.1` with `Host` port verification, `Content-Type` enforcement, `Origin` / `X-Context-Relay` CSRF checks, and CSP headers. --- ## Architecture ```text ContextRelay/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity root plugin manifest (v0.2.2, strict whitelist) ├── hooks.json # Root PreInvocation (0-token nudge) + Stop (incremental sync) ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Square plugin icon │ ├── savings-benchmark.svg # Real-world token-savings benchmark card (820×300) │ └── workflow-preview.svg # Native zero-UI /fork experience preview (820×272) ├── hooks/ │ ├── nudge.mjs # 0-token PreInvocation context bloat reminder │ └── sync-turn.mjs # Lightweight Stop-hook incremental transcript indexer ├── skills/ │ ├── fork/SKILL.md # Primary one-click /fork slash command │ ├── relay/SKILL.md # Hidden backward-compatible alias │ └── context-relay/SKILL.md # Hidden backward-compatible alias ├── adapters/ # Host adapter abstraction (Antigravity + .pbtxt live titles) ├── core/ # Turn parser, smart pruning, Git anchor, 20-class redactor, store ├── bin/context-relay.mjs # Unified CLI (fork, stats --svg, search, inspect, export, install) ├── server/ & ui/ # Optional offline loopback web debugger (serve) └── test/ # 67 unit, redaction, concurrency, hook, CLI & manifest tests ``` All host-specific transcript discovery, annotation parsing, and clean-relaunch transport live cleanly inside `adapters/`, keeping the surgical pruning, Git grounding, secret redaction, and indexing engine host-agnostic for future coding agents. --- ## Testing ```bash node --test test/*.test.mjs ``` ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 KennyMcSimpson
latestReleaseNotes:
## Context Relay v0.2.2 — Zero-UI Native `/fork` & Live Sidebar Title Sync

100% local, zero-dependency Node.js ESM (`>= 22.15.0`) plugin for **Google Antigravity**.

### Highlights
- **One-Click Zero-UI `/fork`**: Cleans bloated tool logs & repeated reads deterministically (0 LLM calls), grounds real local `git status`/`git diff`, preserves 100% verbatim goals & conclusions with lossless `transcript_full.jsonl` traceback, redacts 20 secret classes, inherits your model, and replies with a 2-line receipt + instant `conversation://<id>` jump link.
- **Live Sidebar Title Sync (Zero `.sqlite`)**: Reads Antigravity's plain-text `annotations/<id>.pbtxt` so renamed sidebar titles are inherited cleanly (`Auth Refactor` -> `Auth Refactor (fork)` -> `Auth Refactor (fork #2)`).
- **0-Token Context Bloat Nudge**: `PreInvocation` hook nudges subtly with 0 model tokens when context bloats, aligning `/compact` (in-place) vs `/fork` (fresh denoised session).
- **Shareable Token-Savings War-Report**: `/fork stats` and `node bin/context-relay.mjs stats --svg ./my-savings.svg`.

### Quick Install
```bash
git clone https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/ContextRelay.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-relay
```

### Verification
- `67 / 67` automated unit, redaction, concurrency, hook, CLI & manifest tests passing (`node --test test/*.test.mjs`).
